profile.summary: Niroga Institute is a nonprofit based in Alameda, California, founded in 2005. It teaches a movement-based mindfulness practice called Dynamic Mindfulness (DMind) to help people build resilience, empathy and social-emotional skills. It works with schools, workplaces, mental health clinics, juvenile justice facilities and other communities exposed to high stress.
